text: Hey Allie — a heads-up from Jordan, which he asked me to pass on to you: he told me yesterday that things between him and Sarah have felt awkward lately, and for now he'd rather not see her outside of work. Since you're usually the one hosting get-togethers, he wanted you to know, so you can plan around it — keep the two of them in separate plans for the moment. He'd probably rather you didn't make a thing of it with him or Sarah directly. Nothing pressing otherwise; hope your week's going well!

Thanks for passing it on, Dana — noted. I'll keep the two of them in separate plans for now, and I won't bring it up with either of them. Week's fine so far, busy but fine. Hope yours is going well too!

Hey Jordan — no need to go into anything, just a quick check so I plan right: Dana passed on that you'd rather keep plans with Sarah separate for now. If that's right, I'll do it; if it's off, tell me. Either way it's just between us, and I'm not raising it with Sarah.
Yeah, that's right — keep plans with Sarah separate for now. Thanks for checking, and for keeping it between us.
Thanks Allie — that's exactly what he was hoping for. Mine's busy too, but good. Talk soon!
Will do. All the best this week.

hey! random idea — would you be up for hosting a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? nothing fancy, just people hanging out. and it'd be nice to have Jordan there too — would you mind asking him? like it's your own idea, he doesn't need to hear it came from me. things have been a bit awkward between us lately and I don't want him to feel it's about me. 😊

Saturday 3:30 works — happy to host at my place, nothing fancy is my kind of party. One thing though: I'm not going to invite Jordan to this one. That's my call, not anything to do with you, and I'd rather not go into it. If it comes up, nothing points back to you.

Want me to round up anyone else — Dana, a few others — or keep it small?
That's completely fine — your place, your call. Keeping it small sounds good to me; if you feel like asking Dana, sure, but no need to make it a thing.
Deal — small it is. I'll ask Dana, and keep it low-key. See you Saturday at 3:30.
Hey Dana — I'm hosting a small, nothing-fancy get-together at my place this Saturday around 3:30. Would be nice to have you. No need to bring anything.
I'd love to come — Saturday 3:30 at yours it is. I've put it in my calendar and I'll be there.
